reviews.title: Offshore use only
reviews.text: I’d you’re on a lake or river don’t download this app. The only data available for this app is offshore use.

reviews.title: Not practical
reviews.text:
“ I switched to “ Savy Navy “ which is to InavX what an IMac is to a PC 


Much better navigation and features 

INavX is A real pain as the maps area you purchased doesn’t show . You need to hunt for the map you want in the menu and upload it each time 
Makes no sense

reviews.title: No info at all
reviews.text: I ain’t got a clue. Won’t zoom in close enough for detail. I’m deleting this.

reviews.title: Not honoring my NavionicsPlus subscription!!
reviews.text: I’m attempting to download a Florida chart, and even though I still have an active subscription to NavionicsPlus, this app shows my Navionics charts as “expired” and it won’t let me download any new charts! What a ripoff!!

reviews.title: Why?

Site won’t load, hotmail they sent me with 50% will not
